> Keyboard shortcuts                                                                                               1/81
  [Keys]  Commands
  / type to filter
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Anywhere
> Shift+Tab                                 cycle the permission mode
  Ctrl+K                                    clear the conversation
  Ctrl+T                                    focus the subagent dock
  Ctrl+O                                    show or hide thinking tokens
  Ctrl+E                                    expand the last tool result
  Ctrl+G                                    edit the draft in an external editor
  Ctrl+V                                    paste an image
  PgUp / PgDn                               scroll the transcript
  Ctrl+C Ctrl+C                             quit
  Ctrl+P                                    open the command palette
  F2                                        open settings
  Alt+Up                                    focus the transcript, a block at a time

  Composer
  Tab                                       complete a command, path or mention
  Ctrl+J / Shift+Enter / Alt+Enter          insert a newline
  Esc                                       clear the draft
  Enter                                     send the message
  Up                                        previous prompt from history
  Down / Ctrl+N                             next prompt from history
  Alt+B / Alt+<-                            move one word left
  Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+_                           undo the last draft edit
  Alt+Z                                     redo the draft edit
  Ctrl+W / Alt+Backspace                    cut the word before the cursor
  Ctrl+U                                    cut to the start of the line
  Alt+K                                     cut to the end of the line
  Alt+D                                     cut the next word
  Ctrl+Y                                    paste the last cut text
